# Task P2-13a: Import service — verify, tag, name, place, record; reject and try the next candidate

**Phase:** 2 · **Depends on:** P2-04, P2-05 (probe, verifier), P2-06 (tags), P2-07 (naming), P2-08 (queue), P2-09 (placement), P2-12 (grab service) · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker · **Estimated size:** M · **Risky area:** file moves, correctness (reviewer agent)

## Goal
When a download has finished, turn it into a library file — or refuse it — without human help (ARCHITECTURE §5.2 steps 8–11, MATCHING_ENGINE §6.5): verify it is the wanted recording, check its measured quality against the profile, write the full tag set with the cover, render its path with the library's template, place it (recycling the file it upgrades), and record `song_file` and history. A refused file is blocklisted **for this song**, the peer's reputation drops, the download is deleted, and the next accepted candidate of the same search is grabbed automatically (at most `search.max_auto_attempts_per_search` attempts). An AcoustID outage defers the import instead of importing unverified.

## Deliverables
Namespace `Wondarr.Core.Importing`.

1. `src/Wondarr.Core/Importing/QueueEvents.cs` — `sealed record QueueItemChangedEvent(long QueueItemId, long SongId, QueueItemState State) : IEvent` and `sealed record SongImportedEvent(long SongId, long SongFileId, bool Upgraded) : IEvent` (Core `IEvent`, `src/Wondarr.Core/Messaging/`).
2. `src/Wondarr.Core/Importing/TagSetBuilder.cs` — `static TagSet Build(Song song, AlbumContext album, IReadOnlyList<(Artist Artist, ArtistRole Role)> artists, VerificationResult verification, byte[]? cover)` mapping LIBRARY_OUTPUT §7.3–7.5: `Title` = `song.Title`; `Artist` = `song.ArtistCredit`; `Artists` = all credited names in order; `AlbumArtist` = `album.AlbumArtist`; `Album` = `album.AlbumTitle`; track/disc numbers and totals from the album context (disc total: null → 1 when a disc number exists); `Date` = `album.Date`; `OriginalDate` = `album.OriginalDate`; `Isrc` = first of `song.Isrcs`; `MbRecordingId` = `song.MbRecordingId`; `MbReleaseId` = `album.AlbumKey` (the real release MBID **or** the synthetic pseudo-album UUID — one id per folder); `MbReleaseGroupId` = `album.MbReleaseGroupId`; `MbArtistId` = the primary artist's `MbArtistId`; `MbAlbumArtistId` = `89ad4ac3-39f7-470e-963a-56509c546377` when `album.IsVariousArtists`, else the primary artist's; `ReleaseType` from `album.Kind` (`album`, `single`, `ep`, `compilation`; `PseudoSingles` → `album`); `ReleaseStatus` `official`; `AcoustId` = `verification.AcoustId`; `Compilation` = `album.IsVariousArtists`; `FrontCover` = `cover`.
3. `src/Wondarr.Core/Importing/NamingValuesBuilder.cs` — `static NamingValues Build(Song song, AlbumContext album, Artist primaryArtist, MediaInfo media, Quality quality, string sourceType)`: `ArtistName` = primary artist name, `AlbumArtistName` = `album.AlbumArtist`, `AlbumTitle`, `AlbumType` (as above, capitalised), `ReleaseYear` = first 4 digits of `album.Date`, `OriginalYear` from `album.OriginalDate`, `TrackTitle` = `song.Title`, `TrackArtistName` = `song.ArtistCredit`, `TrackNo`, `DiscNo`, `DiscCount` (null → 1), MBIDs, `Isrc`, `QualityTitle`/`QualityFull` = `quality.Name`, media fields from `MediaInfo`, `Source` = `Soulseek` for `soulseek`, `Version` = the song's non-remaster version flags as a readable phrase (`Live`, `Remix`, `Acoustic`, … joined by `, `; null when none).
4. `src/Wondarr.Core/Importing/CoverFetcher.cs` — `ICoverFetcher` / `CoverFetcher(IHttpClientFactory, ILogger<CoverFetcher>)`: `Task<byte[]?> FetchAsync(string? url, CancellationToken)` — GET with a named client `wondarr-cover` (20 s timeout, the descriptive User-Agent used by the metadata clients), accept only `image/jpeg`/`image/png` responses up to 10 MB (sniff the magic bytes; anything else → null), any failure → null with a Debug log. Register the named client.
5. `src/Wondarr.Core/Importing/ImportService.cs` — `IImportService` / `ImportService(WondarrDbContext, IDownloadVerifier, ITagWriter, IFilePlacer, ICoverFetcher, IBlocklistService, ISoulseekUserService, IHistoryService, ISongSearchService, IEventAggregator, IOptionsMonitor<SearchOptions>, TimeProvider, ILogger<ImportService>)`, **scoped**:
   - `Task<ImportOutcome> ImportAsync(long queueItemId, CancellationToken)`; `enum ImportOutcome { Imported, Upgraded, Rejected, Deferred, Failed, NotReady }`.
   - Load the queue item **tracked** (with `Candidate`), and the song with artists (+ `Artist`), album context, file (+ quality), quality profile and library. `State` must be `Completed` with a `DownloadPath` that exists, else `NotReady` (a missing file → treat as `Failed` "Downloaded file is missing: <path>" and go to *Next attempt*). Set `State = Importing`, save, publish `QueueItemChangedEvent`.
   - **Verify** (`DownloadVerifier.VerifyAsync` with the song's MBID, title, main artists, duration, flags and the profile's `DurationToleranceMs`):
     - `Deferred` → `State = Completed`, `NextCheckAt = now + 15 min`, `Message` = the reason; return `Deferred`.
     - `Failed` → **Reject** with the reason.
     - `NeedsReview` → continue; remember it (history data `needsReview: true`, `FingerprintVerified = false`).
     - `Passed` → continue. If `LearnedMbRecordingId` is set and the song has no MBID and no other song has it → set `song.MbRecordingId` (history data `learnedMbid`).
   - **Quality:** `measured` = `verification.MeasuredQualityId`. Not `profile.IsAllowed(measured)` → Reject "Measured quality <name> is not allowed by <profile>" (a "FLAC" that is really a lossy file lands here). The song already has a file and the grab was automatic (`SearchRun.Trigger != Manual`) and not `profile.IsUpgrade(current, measured)` → Reject "Not an upgrade: <measured> vs <current>".
   - **Tag:** cover = `CoverFetcher.FetchAsync(album.CoverUrl)`; `ITagWriter.WriteAsync(downloadPath, TagSetBuilder.Build(...))`; failure → Reject "Tagging failed: <error>".
   - **Name:** template = `library.NamingTemplate`, or `NamingTemplate.PresetTemplates[library.Layout]` when empty; extension = the download's extension lower-cased (`mp3`, `flac`, `m4a`, `opus`, `ogg`, …) — never `webm` (refuse with Failed "Refusing to write .webm" — ADR-0006); relative path = `NamingTemplate.Render(template, NamingValuesBuilder.Build(...), new NamingOptions(Extension: ext))`.
   - **Place:** `IFilePlacer.PlaceAsync(new PlacementRequest(downloadPath, library.RootPath, relative, ext, TransferMode.Move, ReplacesPath: song.File?.Path))`. Failure → `State = Failed`, `Message` = the error, history `Failed` with data `{error, finalPath, recycledPath}`, **no** blocklist (not the file's fault) and **no** next attempt (a placement failure is a configuration problem); return `Failed`.
   - **Record:** upsert `song_file` (one per song: update the row in place for an upgrade) with `Path` = the final path, `Size`, `Codec`, `Container`, `BitrateKbps`, `SampleRate`, `BitDepth`, `Channels`, `DurationMs` from `MediaInfo`, `QualityId` = measured, `AcoustId`, `FingerprintVerified`, `SourceType`, `SourceRef` = JSON `{provider, remotePath, candidateId, queueItemId, searchRunId}`, `ImportedAt` = now, `TagsWritten` = JSON of `TagWriteResult.Written`. History `Imported` (or `Upgraded` when a file was replaced) with `QualityId` = measured and data `{path, previousPath?, recycledPath?, verification: reason, score, acoustId, fingerprintScore, needsReview?}`. `ISoulseekUserService.RecordSuccessAsync(provider)` for Soulseek. Queue item → `Imported`, `FinishedAt`, `Progress` 1. Delete the now-empty download folder (the directory of `DownloadPath`, i.e. `<downloads>/<item.Destination>`; only if empty, never recursively). Publish `QueueItemChangedEvent` and `SongImportedEvent`. One `SaveChanges` for the record step.
   - **Reject(reason):** history `Rejected` with data `{reason, candidate displayName, provider, remotePath, verification}`; blocklist `{SongId = song, SourceType, BlocklistKey = candidate key, Reason}` (no expiry); `RecordFailureAsync(provider)`; delete the downloaded file and its folder if empty (only inside the downloads folder: never delete a path outside the directory of `DownloadPath`); queue item → `Failed` with `Message` = reason; publish; then **Next attempt**; return `Rejected`.
   - **Next attempt:** if `item.Attempt < MaxAutoAttemptsPerSearch` → `ISongSearchService.GrabBestAsync(item.SearchRunId, item.Attempt + 1)`; history data of the rejection gets `nextQueueItemId` (or `"no more candidates"`). Never throws out of `ImportAsync` for a failed next grab (log it).
   - Every exception not handled above → queue item `Failed` with the message, logged at Error, return `Failed` (the file stays where it is).
6. Register the service, `ICoverFetcher` and the named client in `AddWondarrCore` (or `AddWondarrMetadata` for the HTTP client if that is where the other named clients live).
7. Tests in `tests/Wondarr.Core.Tests/Importing/` with the SQLite test database, **real** `NamingTemplate`, `TagSetBuilder`, `NamingValuesBuilder`, and fakes for the verifier, tag writer, placer, cover fetcher and search service (record calls): happy path → song_file row, history `Imported`, queue `Imported`, reputation success, events published, template rendered for the seeded default library (`Daft Punk/Random Access Memories/08 - Get Lucky` + `.flac`); upgrade → `ReplacesPath` = old path, `Upgraded`, row updated in place; verifier `Failed` → blocklisted for this song, reputation failure, file deleted, next attempt requested with `Attempt + 1`; attempt budget exhausted → no next grab; `Deferred` → back to `Completed` with `NextCheckAt`; `NeedsReview` → imported with `FingerprintVerified` false; learned MBID set, and not set when another song has it; measured quality not allowed → rejected; not an upgrade → rejected, but a manual search's grab is not; placement failure → `Failed`, no blocklist, no next attempt; `.webm` refused; missing download file → failed + next attempt; `TagSetBuilder` pseudo-album (`AlbumKey` synthetic UUID → `MbReleaseId`; `PseudoSingles` → `album`) and Various Artists (`MbAlbumArtistId`, `Compilation`) mapping.

- `src/Wondarr.Core/Importing/**`, `src/Wondarr.Core/ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs` / `src/Wondarr.Core/Metadata/MetadataServiceCollectionExtensions.cs` (registrations only)
- `tests/Wondarr.Core.Tests/Importing/**`

## Context to read first
- `docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md` §5.2; `docs/architecture/MATCHING_ENGINE.md` §6.5; `docs/architecture/LIBRARY_OUTPUT.md` §7.3–7.5; `docs/build/PHASE_2_TASKS.md` decisions
- `src/Wondarr.Core/Verification/*`, `Media/*`, `Tagging/*`, `Organizer/{NamingTemplate,NamingValues,FilePlacer,RecycleBin}.cs`, `Searching/SongSearchService.cs`, `Sources/{QueueService,SoulseekUserService}.cs`, `Domain/{Song,SongFile,AlbumContext,QueueItem,Library,Quality}.cs`, `Blocklisting/BlocklistService.cs`, `History/HistoryService.cs`, `Messaging/*`
- The P2-08 note: `QueueService.UpdateAsync` treats a **detached** item as a state change and resets `LastProgressAt` — here, always work on the tracked entity loaded in this scope.

## Constraints
- No new packages. Time via `TimeProvider`. Never delete anything outside the download folder of the item. Never import unverified because AcoustID is down.

## Acceptance criteria (each must be demonstrated)
1. `dotnet build -warnaserror` → 0 warnings, 0 errors; `dotnet test` → all pass (paste the summary lines).
2. Every test listed in 7 exists and passes.

## Out of scope
- Polling the source, timeouts, the hosted tracker, SignalR relays (P2-13b); API endpoints (P2-14); lyrics, `cover.jpg`, Plex (Phase 3).
